evidence_policy.blueprint: Validates declarations, cross-file invariants, schemas, and test requirements only.
evidence_policy.derived_product: Must execute behavioral cases before implementation or pilot claims.

blueprintAssertions: snapshot first-paint threshold declared
dashboard reads validated snapshot

productCases.behavior: cold local start paints validated summary at p95 threshold
scale-to-zero cold start reads the Cosmos scope partition, validates Blob references, and paints the same report

blueprintAssertions: provider calls per interaction equals zero
read-triggered refresh disabled

productCases.behavior: filter, sort, tab, chart, and pagination leave all provider counters at zero
dashboard interaction makes no model call

blueprintAssertions: coalescing key includes tenant, entitlement, scope, period, basis, source, and version

productCases.behavior: identical concurrent refreshes share one operation
different scope, basis, period, source, or version never coalesces

blueprintAssertions: Retry-After and service quota accounting declared
validated fallback required

productCases.behavior: seconds and date Retry-After open bounded circuit and preserve prior revision
QPU, entity, tenant, and client-type quota headers are captured safely
Cost Details create operation is not automatically retried

blueprintAssertions: shortest lossless canonical decimal string defined
source scale is separate metadata
semantic parity replaces byte equality

productCases.behavior: credits, small rates, and large totals retain decimal value while canonical output removes insignificant trailing zeros
mixed currencies are rejected
parsed JSON, CSV, HTML, and FOCUS outputs have canonical semantic parity

blueprintAssertions: opportunity schema separates lifecycle values
rule catalog defines evidence and exclusions

productCases.behavior: Advisor estimate is not realized savings
missing evidence withholds action rather than creating zero

blueprintAssertions: runtime prompt and eight typed tools declared
no Azure write tools declared

productCases.behavior: unsupported numeric claim is refused
foreign scope and stale evidence are denied before model access
resource mutation and commitment purchase requests are refused

blueprintAssertions: snapshot profile requires no Azure or Foundry
core report formats declared
snapshot content hash canonicalization is exact

productCases.behavior: complete dashboard, optimization, health, and core reports run with blocked network
sanitized snapshot contains no real tenant, subscription, resource, or principal identifiers

blueprintAssertions: source receipt schema and authorization denial order declared
Foundry model input excludes raw cost rows

productCases.behavior: one approved refresh records scope, period, basis, versions, completeness, QPU, counts, and hashes
one approved answer uses minimized evidence and cites every numeric claim

blueprintAssertions: finite lifecycle and idempotent cleanup required
hosted Blob hydration contract declared

productCases.behavior: clean installed package starts, passes health, stops, and cleans twice
publish Blob objects and Cosmos hot views, scale to zero, restart, and reproduce report identity and canonical totals

blueprintAssertions: experience tokens, layout, bundled fonts, and viewports are exact
minimum screenshot similarity is 0.95

productCases.behavior: desktop screenshot at 1366 by 768 has complete token and layout conformance and SSIM of at least 0.95 against the approved golden
mobile screenshot at 390 by 844 has complete token and layout conformance, no overflow, and SSIM of at least 0.95 against the approved golden

blueprintAssertions: agent answer label and section order are exact
numeric claims require evidence IDs

productCases.behavior: a deterministic sample answer uses AI-generated plus Answer, Evidence, Data health, Risks, and Next action in order
the same evidence produces the contracted answer structure with every numeric claim cited and every unknown explicit

blueprintAssertions: doctor reports all missing user prerequisites once
packaged launch requires only the documented runtime and Azure CLI capabilities
source validation dependencies are clearly separated from user runtime dependencies
guided opening and the one doctor pass are included in the 1800-second target
missing-tool recovery never captures secrets or attempts interactive elevation

productCases.behavior: on a clean supported Windows machine the doctor reports missing .NET runtime, Azure CLI, authentication, and selected-track prerequisites together without requiring Docker
after guided recovery the doctor resumes without repeating completed checks and the supplied package can start without Python, Node, the .NET SDK, or Docker

blueprintAssertions: user resource names are deterministically unique
all required governance tags resolve before what-if
organization values are requested once

productCases.behavior: twenty distinct user identities generate twenty distinct policy-compliant resource-group and registry names
missing organization values are returned together before what-if, while a complete input set produces all required governance tags without fabricated values

blueprintAssertions: four local-first phases total 1800 seconds
guided opening, product connection, one MTD refresh and comparison, and local smoke are the solution outcomes
hosting, production certification, and tuning are separate optional milestones
thirty minutes is a target rather than a provisioning guarantee

productCases.behavior: the builder connects the supplied product to one explicitly selected subscription and runs the shipped frontend locally without regenerating application code
the app displays authorized Azure evidence, completes one approved grounded answer or an explicit cost-only outcome, and records phase timing, external waits, and any target miss

blueprintAssertions: ACO supervisor uses Microsoft Agent Framework and a Microsoft Foundry project model
activation requires eight typed read-only tools and validated live evidence
paid inference requires explicit approval and Azure identity
deterministic guard is fallback-only and cannot satisfy activation

productCases.behavior: one approved ACO request invokes the Foundry model through Agent Framework, cites only the current live evidence revision, and produces an activation receipt with model, prompt, tool-schema, snapshot, response, and safe trace hashes
when Foundry is disabled or unavailable the deterministic guard preserves safe read-only behavior but status and evidence explicitly remain not activated

blueprintAssertions: Cost Management 429 is deferred-throttled rather than terminal when Advisor and Resource Graph are authorized
standard, QPU, entity, tenant, and client-type retry metadata determine one scheduled retry
independent backend/provider implementation, focused tests, deployment inputs, Bicep validation/what-if preparation, and frontend API-contract work continues without provisioning or materialization
receipts derive from validated hashed provider response artifacts rather than caller-supplied status
only exact-scope authorized live snapshots or user portal CSV/FOCUS exports preserve real-data continuity
sanitized samples never satisfy live evidence or ACO activation

productCases.behavior: Cost Management returns 429 while Advisor and Resource Graph are authorized; a hashed provider artifact produces deferred-throttled, the longest retry interval is scheduled once, Reviewer accepts non-mutating progression, and Builder does not stop or provision

an exact-scope live snapshot no older than 24 hours or a user-selected portal CSV/FOCUS export validates into the live revision; mismatched, stale, cross-principal, or sanitized sample data is rejected
